name: Okaya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Okaya city emblem in red: a ring broken at the hoist and fly.
history: Municipal flag of Okaya, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 9 October 1936.

features.role: Okaya city emblem — a ring broken at the hoist and fly
